releaseNotes: Production Release v1.2.0 - Complete Mobile-First Optimization.
Integrated safe-area inset top/bottom padding to eliminate status bar and notch collision on Android.
Responsive Slide-Over Navigation Drawer with quick touch close, school header, and mobile role switcher.
Bottom Navigation Bar for instant thumb-friendly access to Home, Students, Fees/Attendance, Exams, and More.
Full-width fluid responsive layouts for mobile phone screens with horizontal swipeable sub-tabs.
Manager Sir (Lalitesh Kumar Dixit) and Principal (Ram Jiyawan Yadav) two-tier fee approval workflow.
Interactive Fee Calculator with Sibling, EWS, and Staff concessions plus quotation sharing.
Dynamic class-wise Fee Structure Management for Pre-Primary through Class 8.
